sys_app.name: JobPulse — Scheduled Job Health Auditor
sys_app.short_description: Scans the scheduled-job estate for silent failures, orphaned references, overlaps, stale jobs, and ownership gaps

sys_user_role.name: x_jobpulse_admin
sys_user_role.description: Full CRUD on JobPulse tables, execute REST API, configure scheduled job

sys_user_role.name: x_jobpulse_user
sys_user_role.description: Read on JobPulse tables, execute analytics REST API

sys_script_include.description: Core scan engine: walks the sys_trigger estate and runs the full check pipeline (execution health, orphaned references, overlap, stale, ownership)
sys_script_include.name: JobPulseScanner

sys_script_include.description: Analytics engine: composite health scoring, run history, overlap map, ownership report, delta detection, remediation, summary
sys_script_include.name: JobPulseAnalytics

sys_ws_definition.name: JobPulse Execute API
sys_ws_definition.description: Trigger scans and on-demand analytics actions

sys_ws_operation.name: Execute Action

sys_ws_definition.name: JobPulse Analytics API
sys_ws_definition.description: Query analytics reports (summary, overlap, ownership, delta, health, findings)

sys_ws_operation.name: Get Analytics

sysauto_script.description: Scans the scheduled-job estate nightly, upserts findings and health records, and alerts on new critical findings
